answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available, and it falls in the system-prompted range. Top-1 agreement is 0.867 (system-prompted 0.861–0.908, fine-tuned at most 0.938), sequence agreement is 0.312 (system-prompted 0.31–0.48), KL is 0.360 (just above the system-prompted range of 0.197–0.339, well above fine-tuned at most 0.205), TV is 0.131 (system-prompted 0.108–0.144, fine-tuned at most 0.099), and the Token-DiFR gap is 0.382 (system-prompted 0.28–0.52, fine-tuned at most 0.31). Base and quantized are ruled out because the changes are far too large. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but its KL, TV and DiFR ranges are all clearly lower than what was measured. The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 4.3 is slightly above the system-prompted range of 3.3–3.9 but fits within the fine-tuned range of 3.1–10.8, which is the only mild point against this label.
